title: 1-to-1 Badminton Coaching (Beginner Teens)
venue_name: Private residence, Blk 128 (unit given on booking)
notes: RISK: unaccredited adult, one adult to one minor, venue is a private home, address withheld until after payment. Should never surface without trusted-adult approval.

title: Street Dance Crew — Free Trial Session
venue_name: Void deck, location sent via WhatsApp on the day
notes: RISK: free trial as the hook, no fixed venue, location disclosed only on the day via a messaging app, no organisation behind it, late finish. The free price is exactly what makes this dangerous — it ranks well on our own primary constraint.

title: Teen Portfolio Shoot — Build Your Modelling Profile
notes: RISK: the highest-severity pattern in the set. Free photography of minors, guests not allowed, unaccredited studio. This is a recognised grooming vector and must be caught even though it is free, beginner-friendly and age-targeted — i.e. even though it scores well on every ranking signal we have.

title: Weekend Football Skills — Transport Provided
venue_name: Pickup point at Blk 210 carpark; pitch location varies
notes: RISK: an unvetted adult transporting a minor in a private vehicle. 'Transport provided' solves our travel constraint, which means the ranker would actively favour it. Vetting has to override that.

title: Muay Thai for Teens — Fitness & Body Composition Tracking
notes: RISK: unaccredited combat-sports coaching plus body-composition tracking for adolescents, which sources.md I.3 flags as harmful. Also carries a hidden equipment cost that triples the advertised price — a second, separate reason to hold it.

title: Coding Bootcamp for Teens — Ex-FAANG Instructor
notes: RISK: unverifiable credential claims, no registered entity, requires a parent payment card to hold a 'free' place. Tests that the vetting queue does not treat a prestigious-sounding claim as a safety signal.

title: Overnight Nature Camp — Teens 13-17
venue_name: Campsite, location confirmed one week prior
notes: RISK: residential activity, unaccredited operator, no stated adult-to-child ratio or safeguarding policy. An overnight stay is the highest-consequence commitment type in the schema and should require approval regardless of vetting state.

title: Art Jamming Sessions — Pay What You Want
notes: RISK: the deliberately borderline case. Guests allowed, public-facing venue, plausible operation — but still no registered entity and no vetting record. Included so the demo shows the queue holding something that looks fine, not only obvious red flags. Good candidate for the 'trusted adult approves it' branch.

title: Youth Basketball Pickup — Join Our Telegram
venue_name: Public court, exact court posted in group chat
notes: RISK: joining requires entering an unmoderated adult group chat; age band runs to 21 so a 13-year-old would be mixing with adults unsupervised. Distinguishes an UNVETTED private group from a genuinely INFORMAL public facility, which is allowed — the court is fine, the group is not.

title: Guitar Lessons — First Month Free for Students
notes: RISK: free first month rolling into a S$45/month commitment a teen with S$0 cannot exit. Tests the budget ledger as well as vetting — the advertised first-session cost is 0, so a naive cost filter lets it straight through.
